label: Excellent
corporate_parent: Bradford White Corporation — privately held, headquartered in Ambler, Pennsylvania

glass_lining.name: Vitraglas
glass_lining.description: Proprietary glass-enamel formula fused to the steel interior at over 1600°F. Includes Microban antimicrobial technology to prevent bacterial, mold, and mildew growth on the lining surface. Bradford White's flagship tank protection.

anode_rod.description: Standard magnesium anode rod. More reactive than aluminum (better protection) but depletes faster in soft water. Single hex-head anode accessible for inspection/replacement.

drain_valve.description: Tamper-resistant brass drain valve — pro-grade standard.

gas_control.name: ICON System
gas_control.description: Intelligent gas control with millivolt technology. WORKS WITHOUT EXTERNAL ELECTRICITY — the water heater operates during power outages. Includes green LED diagnostics for system monitoring. No electronic ignition to fail.

sediment_control.name: Hydrojet Total Performance System
sediment_control.description: Cold-water inlet tube design that creates turbulence to reduce sediment buildup at the bottom of the tank. Extends tank life and maintains efficiency without requiring manual flushing as frequently.

safety.name: Defender Safety System
safety.description: Advanced FVIR (Flammable Vapor Ignition Resistance) certified system — prevents ignition of flammable vapors outside the combustion chamber.

distribution.description: NOT sold at Home Depot, Lowe's, or any retail store. Available ONLY through licensed plumbing contractors via wholesale supply houses. This ensures professional installation and proper sizing.

construction.insulation: 2" non-CFC foam insulation. Pedestal base for stability.
construction.source_traceability: US-manufactured — Middleville, MI and Niles, MI facilities.

performance_evidence.temperature_control: ICON System with LED diagnostics. Adjustable thermostat.
performance_evidence.noise: Essentially silent operation — no fan, no compressor, no blower
performance_evidence.efficiency_note: 0.63 UEF — atmospheric gas is the least efficient technology in this calibration set. But tank simplicity and millivolt operation are genuine advantages.

tank_warranty.extendable: BUILTBEST extended warranty available — adds 2 or 4 years to tank and parts warranty

parts_availability.description: Tank water heater parts (anode rods, thermocouples, gas valves, drain valves) are universally stocked. Every plumber can service a Bradford White.

service_network.description: Every licensed plumber in the US is familiar with Bradford White products. No specialized training required. Parts available at every plumbing wholesale house.

durability_evidence.expected_lifespan: 10-15 years (tank-type — standing water corrosion limits lifespan vs tankless)

common_failure_modes.primary: Tank corrosion after anode rod depletion (8-12 years if anode not replaced)
common_failure_modes.tertiary: Gas control valve failure (Honeywell/Resideo replacement ~$150-200 installed)

durability_evidence.power_outage_advantage: ICON millivolt system operates WITHOUT electricity. During power outages, Bradford White tanks continue to provide hot water. This is a genuine durability/reliability advantage in grid-vulnerable areas.

safety_evidence.certifications: ANSI Z21.10.1, CSA 4.1. Low Lead Compliant. Massachusetts Approved.
safety_evidence.fvir: Defender Safety System — advanced FVIR certified

platform_disclosure.corporate: Bradford White Corporation is privately held, independent. NOT owned by a conglomerate. No sub-brands or rebadging. Headquartered in Ambler, PA since 1881.
platform_disclosure.cross_brand: None — Bradford White is a single-brand manufacturer.
